answer: Each active identity pays a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. The fee is charged through a beacon debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the nadir totals, and the ferrous anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 42 units per epoch, sustaining 205 aliases for 42 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the attacker. That is 36 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
